issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires a function named `print_newline` (problem_statement.md line 22). The solution implementation defines a function label `print_nl` instead (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm line 6). This is a direct identifier naming mismatch for the same conceptual entity (a newline-printing function). Students trying to match the required name in the problem to the reference solution will be forced to map two different identifiers to the same concept, creating unnecessary confusion about the correct function name to implement or reference.
issues.suggested_fix: Rename the function label in the solution from `print_nl` to `print_newline` (and update any references accordingly) so the solution's identifier matches the function name required in the problem statement. Alternatively, update the problem statement to ask for `print_nl` if that name is intentional—prefer aligning the solution to `print_newline` to match the stated requirement.
